services.name: Field Trips
services.desc: Every visit to the Lab is a fun and educational one! We welcome school groups, scouts, camps, and other organizations to visit us. Our exhibits are thoughtfully designed to accommodate a wide range of ages, interests, and developmental stages from birth to 6th grade. We have created accessible opportunities for children to interact with our educational and play-based space. If you are interested in deep diving into STEAM, Discovery Lab offers educational classes you can add to your field trip.
